_comment: system-sender.v1.json — policy data for lib/system_sender.py, the system's own outbound sender (mail through New Outlook, social through Blotato). Authority: Joe's autonomy ruling of 2026-10-12, decision cbe91287-10a2-48d0-bda7-3b1784b4bb93 ("I don't even want credential minting, external sends, mailbox and CRM consent ... to require me"), and rule c66dc739 as amended the same day: sending is no longer a human gate. The gate is this policy chain instead: kill switch, writing lint, recipient allowlist, dedupe, daily caps, shadow mode, receipts. SHADOW MODE: while live_from is null or in the future, every call runs the whole chain and records would_send, and nothing leaves the machine. Going live is an edit of live_from to an ISO-8601 timestamp with an offset, through an ordinary PR. Never put a credential value in this file; the Blotato key is named in ops/config/credential-inventory.v1.json (blotato-api-key) and lives where that row says.

mail._self_addresses_note: Joe's and Dell's own CARR addresses, the same pair bin/gmail-handover.py allows. Any other recipient must be an exact participant email on the deal named in the call, read live through get-call-context.

social._platforms_note: A platform must be listed here AND carry an accountId in accounts_file; the account and page ids come from that file, never from the caller.

kill_switch._note: Either one stops every send: the stop file existing, or an open or claimed record-layer signal of this kind (read through next-signals). A kill-switch read that fails refuses the send.
